title: On finite trifactorised groups and Sylow and Hall theorems for skew braces
summary: The aim of this short note is to show that the Sylow theorem (respectively Hall theorem) for finite skew braces proved by Truman in arXiv:2606.18414 is a direct consequence of the Sylow structure (resp. Hall structure) of a finite trifactorised group. A Cauchy theorem for finite skew braces naturally emerges.
